text: The Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
ශී ලංකා පජාතාන්තික සමාජවාදී ජනරජෙය් ගැසට් පතය

Notice under Section 7 My No. : WGSWD&EIP/ACQ/KB/33. Tourism & Lands Min's Ref No.: 4/3/10/2016/LRB/67. I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the State has acquired the land located adjacent to Karadiyana Waste Recycling Centre and Weras Ganga, to maintain a water retention area and resettle the persons those who were displaced due to this project under Weras Ganga Storm Water Drainage and Environment Improvement project. Description of the land to be acquired : The below mentioned allotment of land, depicted in below lot numbers in Sheet No. 05, Block No. 16 of the Cadastral Map No. 521203 dated 07.04.2021 prepared by the Surveyor General situated in the villages called Thumbowila in the Grama Niladhari Divisions No. 576 A of Tumbowila North in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Kesbewa in Colombo District of the Western Province and bounded as follows: 01. Lot No. 196 Name of the land: Dunuhinga Kumbura, Karadiyana Kumbura and Maaweekotuwa; Description : Home garden; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Mrs. Sarika Alwis Weerakkodi, Mrs. Ruwani Dilhari Alwis

Weerakkodi, Mrs. Chamari Udayanginee Alwis Weerakkodi, No. 82,Elhena Road, Maharagama; Extent : 0.3160 Hectare. All persons interested in the aforesaid land/ servitude on which a servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Land Acquisition Office located in the Head Office of the Sri Lanka Land Reclamation and Development Corporation, No. 03, Sri Jayawardenapura Mawatha, Welikada, Rajagiriya on 23rd October 2024 at 10.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 16th October 2024, the nature, of their interests in the land/lands, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land/servitude, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount. H. THILAKAWARDHANA, Acquiring Officer, Weras Ganga Storm Water Drainage & Environment Improvement Project, Divisional Secretary's Division - Kesbewa. Weras Ganga Storm Water Drainage & Environment Improvement Project, No. 03, Sri Jayawardenapura Mawatha, Welikada, Rajagiriya. On12th of September,2024 EOG 09-0159
